title: One emoji or curly quote doubles the number of SMS segments you pay for
symptoms: num_segments is 2 for a message well under 160 characters
Messaging bill per message is higher than the character count suggests
cause: A single character outside GSM-7, such as an emoji or a smart quote pasted from a word processor, switches the whole message to UCS-2, which fits 70 characters per segment, or 67 when split. Twilio bills per segment.
fix: Normalize quotes and dashes before sending, avoid emoji in bulk sends, or turn on Smart Encoding in the Messaging Service. Check numSegments on the returned message.
affected: SMS on all Twilio senders; segment sizes checked October 2026
